notes: Full pipeline from the repo's only script: cleans/renames 5 IPEDS extract tables (salaries, tuition & costs, characteristics, age distribution, graduation), engineers mf_staff_ratio/average_salary/avg_tuition/avg_fee/region/graduation_rate, sorts and 4-way merges them, then fits the author's original PROC GLM model (same CLASS/MODEL predictors), PROC PRINT, and PROC SGPLOT scatter+reg exactly as written. Adaptation: the original reads five tables through an external `ipeds` libname plus a PROC FORMAT CNTLIN= catalog that only exist on the authors' local SAS session -- neither is redistributable, so this bundle inlines small fabricated DATALINES tables with matching column shapes (12 institutions) in place of the libname reads, and drops the CNTLIN format catalog load (not exercised by the modeling logic). All fabricated values are aggregate institution-level figures (total staff counts, total salary outlays, tuition, room/board, graduation cohort counts) mirroring IPEDS' own public aggregate grain -- no real IPEDS extract and no individual-level salary data was used or is shipped. One field (`locale`) is included in the mock characteristics table unrenamed, passing through the SET statement exactly as the author's real IPEDS characteristics extract would have, since the original PROC GLM CLASS/MODEL statements reference it directly.
